conns.r: 1985 — twin centerpiece of MTV meta-commentary; 'I Want My MTV' and the Les Garland DJ bridge both enact the network's self-awareness within the year's biggest rock hits
Direct lineage — same band DNA, counterculture origin that this 1985 record had fully commercialized
Adjacent MTV-era high-rotation artifact; same programming cycle where Les Garland's programming choices shaped the channel's mid-80s aesthetic
Director Francis Delia's adjacent mid-80s video work in the same rapid-cut MTV-ready performance vocabulary
Contemporaneous MTV-dominant single — 1985 chart environment that 'We Built This City' fought and topped at #1
